messages.subject: Time recording outstanding - April
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

Our records show unposted time for the period to 28 April. Please ensure all time is recorded and released by 12:00 on 2 May so that April bills can be raised on schedule. Matters with WIP over 60 days will be flagged to the relevant partner.

Regards,
Accounts
